CustomField.label: Status ärger?
CustomField.description: Three-state AErger-Indicator at the customer (SCRUM-442, AC5). "Kein Daten" if no closed Case in the 3-month window (PO-Decision: must NOT read as satisfied); "AErger" if the 3-month average is below 3.0 OR at least one Case with score 1 or 2 in the window (min <= 2); else "OK". formulaTreatBlanksAs is BlankAsNull deliberately — BlankAsZero would turn "no data" into 0, which is < 3 and would flag every customer without closed Cases as AErger. House shape SCRUM-398 Eskalationsstufe__c / SCRUM-382 Customer_Since_Days__c.
